newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn gold revaluation plan "sensible" - Hintze.
newsitem.headline: Bonn gold revaluation plan "sensible" - Hintze.

text.p: A top lieutenant of Chancellor Helmut Kohl on Friday defended Bonn's plan to revalue Budnesbank gold and rejected speculation that Finance Minister Theo Waigel would resign.
The revaluation plan was economically and politically sensible, said Peter Hintze, general secretary of Kohl's Christian Democrats, told Deutschlandfunk radio.
He also said the Bundesbank would eventually agree to the revaluation and that the dispute centred on the right timing for the move.

The Bundesbank on Wednesday rejected Waigel's plan to revalue its reserves in an effort to bolster government finances as Bonn strives to close a gaping budget deficit and qualify for European monetary union.
Asked if Waigel would step down under the massive criticism of the revaluation plan, Hintze said, "No".
Greens party member Kerstin Mueller told ARD television opposition parties would demand Waigel's resignation in parliament next week. -- Bonn Newsroom, +49-228 26097150
